title: Auto Glass Services Customer Terms: Reschedule and Cancellation Figures
content:
These customer terms state the figures that govern changes to an **Auto Glass Services** appointment at Crestline Collision & Glass: the reschedule cutoff, the number of customer-requested reschedules allowed on one job, the cancellation cutoff, and the late-cancellation fee, for every glass tier.

**Term A — Reschedule cutoff.** Latest hours before the appointment start at which the customer may reschedule (integer, hours).

**Term B — Reschedules allowed.** Customer-requested reschedules allowed on one job (integer).

**Term C — Cancellation cutoff.** Hours before the appointment start inside which a cancellation is late (integer, hours; 0 means never late).

**Term D — Late-cancellation fee.** Fee on a late cancellation or a missed appointment of a job whose glass was ordered (USD).

| Tier | A. Reschedule cutoff (hours) | B. Reschedules allowed | C. Cancellation cutoff (hours) | D. Late-cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Side Glass Replacement | 4 | 2 | 24 | 0.00 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 4 | 2 | 24 | 35.00 |
| Windshield Replacement | 4 | 2 | 24 | 0.00 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 24 | 2 | 24 | 45.00 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 24 | 2 | 48 | 95.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- Every tier allows 2 customer-requested reschedules on one job.
- The reschedule cutoff is 2 hours on Windshield Chip Repair, 4 hours on Side Glass Replacement, Rear Glass Replacement and Windshield Replacement, and 24 hours on Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
- On Windshield Chip Repair the cancellation cutoff is 0, so a cancellation of that tier is never late. The cancellation cutoff is 24 hours on four tiers and 48 hours on Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
- A late-cancellation fee other than 0.00 is scheduled on three tiers: 35.00 on Rear Glass Replacement, 45.00 on Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and 95.00 on Premium Feature Windshield Replacement. Side Glass Replacement and Windshield Replacement have a 24-hour cancellation cutoff but a fee of 0.00.

## Hypothetical readings

| Hypothetical situation | Figure that applies |
|---|---|
| A Premium Feature Windshield Replacement appointment is cancelled 30 hours before its start | 30 hours lies inside the 48-hour cancellation cutoff, so the cancellation is late under Term C; Term D's figure for the tier is 95.00 |
| A Rear Glass Replacement appointment is cancelled 30 hours before its start | 30 hours lies outside the 24-hour cancellation cutoff, so the cancellation is not late under Term C |
| A Windshield Chip Repair appointment is cancelled 1 hour before its start | the cutoff is 0, never late |
